newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria places 9.695 bln levs of special T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria places 9.695 bln levs of special T-bills.

text.p: Bulgaria's Finance Ministry placed six special issues of floater coupon T-bills, all dated September 4, with a total par value of 9.695 billion levs, the Bulgarian National Bank (BNB) said.
The coupons of all issues were set equal to the BNB's central interest rate (CIR) for the periods to maturity. The CIR is now set at an annual 108 percent.
The issues were placed with the United Bulgarian Bank, the State Savings Bank and the State Insurance Institute, a Finance Ministry official, who declined to be named, told Reuters.
The paper was placed on Wednesday and was part of a series of 10 regular and special issues offered by the ministry to raise funds for 24.3 billion levs of maturity payments on three previous issues.
